# Shopify
> Shopify is a commerce platform for building, customizing, and operating online stores, retail systems, and commerce apps.

This llms.txt focuses on Shopify’s developer and technical resources across APIs, app development, themes, storefronts, admin tooling, and platform guides. It prioritizes stable documentation and reference pages useful for LLM-assisted development.

## Developer Home
- [Shopify Dev](https://shopify.dev/): Main developer portal for Shopify platform documentation, APIs, tools, and guides.
- [Documentation](https://shopify.dev/docs): Central index for Shopify developer docs across apps, themes, APIs, and storefronts.
- [API Reference](https://shopify.dev/docs/api): Entry point for Admin, Storefront, Customer Account, and partner-facing APIs.
- [Developer Changelog](https://shopify.dev/changelog): Product and platform updates affecting Shopify development workflows and integrations.
- [Shopify Partners](https://www.shopify.com/partners): Partner program information for app developers, agencies, and solution providers.

## Admin API
- [Admin API Overview](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin): Overview of Shopify’s primary API for store administration and commerce operations.
- [GraphQL Admin API Reference](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql): GraphQL schema reference for products, orders, customers, and store configuration.
- [REST Admin API Reference](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-rest): Legacy REST reference for administrative resources and store management endpoints.
- [Admin API Authentication](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/auth): Authentication patterns for embedded apps and Admin API access.
- [API Versioning](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/usage/versioning): Shopify API versioning policy, release cadence, and upgrade expectations.
- [Rate Limits](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/usage/rate-limits): Request throttling behavior and limits for Shopify APIs.

## App Development
- [Build an App](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build): Guides for creating public and custom apps on Shopify.
- [App Architecture](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/architecture): Core concepts for embedded apps, extensions, and backend integration design.
- [Authentication](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/authentication-authorization): OAuth and session token flows for Shopify app authorization.
- [App Distribution](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/distribution): Options for distributing public, custom, and private Shopify apps.
- [Webhooks](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/webhooks): Subscribe to Shopify events and process asynchronous store changes.
- [Billing for Apps](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/launch/billing): Implement recurring, usage-based, and one-time app charges.

## App Extensions
- [App Extensions Overview](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/app-extensions): Introduction to extension points for Shopify app functionality.
- [Admin UI Extensions](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/admin/actions-blocks): Extend Shopify Admin with actions and blocks in merchant workflows.
- [Checkout UI Extensions](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/checkout): Customize checkout experiences using Shopify’s extension framework.
- [Customer Account UI Extensions](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/customer-accounts): Add app functionality to Shopify customer account surfaces.
- [Flow Actions and Triggers](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/flow): Integrate apps with Shopify Flow automation actions and triggers.
- [Functions](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/functions): Run custom backend logic inside Shopify commerce workflows.

## Storefronts and Headless
- [Storefronts Overview](https://shopify.dev/docs/storefronts): Documentation for Liquid themes, Hydrogen, and headless storefront development.
- [Storefront API](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront): GraphQL API for building custom storefronts and buyer experiences.
- [Hydrogen](https://shopify.dev/docs/storefronts/headless/hydrogen): React framework for custom Shopify storefronts.
- [Oxygen](https://shopify.dev/docs/storefronts/headless/oxygen): Shopify-hosted deployment platform for Hydrogen storefronts.
- [Headless](https://shopify.dev/docs/storefronts/headless): Concepts and guides for decoupled commerce architectures on Shopify.
- [Customer Account API](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/customer): API for authenticated customer account experiences and self-service flows.

## Themes and Liquid
- [Themes Overview](https://shopify.dev/docs/storefronts/themes): Documentation for building, customizing, and maintaining Shopify themes.
- [Liquid Reference](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid): Reference for Shopify’s Liquid templating language, objects, tags, and filters.
- [Theme Architecture](https://shopify.dev/docs/storefronts/themes/architecture): Core theme structure, templates, sections, blocks, and assets.
- [Theme Best Practices](https://shopify.dev/docs/storefronts/themes/best-practices): Recommendations for performance, maintainability, and merchant-friendly theme design.
- [Theme App Extensions](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/online-store/theme-app-extensions): Add app blocks and embeds to themes without direct code edits.
- [Online Store 2.0](https://shopify.dev/docs/storefronts/themes/architecture/sections): Section-based theme capabilities introduced with Online Store 2.0.

## Shopify CLI and Tooling
- [Shopify CLI](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/shopify-cli): Command-line tooling for apps, themes, and local development workflows.
- [App Development with CLI](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/cli-for-apps): Use Shopify CLI to scaffold, run, and deploy apps.
- [Theme Development with CLI](https://shopify.dev/docs/storefronts/themes/tools/cli): Local theme development, preview, and deployment using Shopify CLI.
- [GraphiQL App](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/usage/api-exploration/admin-graphiql-explorer): Explore and test Shopify GraphQL APIs interactively.
- [Dev Dashboard](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/tools/development-stores): Development stores and testing environments for Shopify app and theme work.

## B2B, Markets, and Commerce Features
- [B2B on Shopify](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/b2b): Build solutions for wholesale and business-to-business commerce workflows.
- [Markets](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/markets): International commerce concepts for localization, pricing, and regional selling.
- [Subscriptions](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/purchase-options/subscriptions): Build subscription purchase options and recurring commerce experiences.
- [Bundles](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/product-merchandising/bundles): Support bundled products and merchandising use cases in Shopify apps.
- [Discounts with Functions](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/discounts): Create custom discount logic using Shopify Functions.
- [Cart and Checkout Customization](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/checkout): Extend cart and checkout behavior with supported Shopify surfaces.

## Webhooks, Events, and Data
- [Webhooks Overview](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/webhooks): Event delivery model for store changes and app integrations.
- [Webhook HTTPS Delivery](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/webhooks/subscribe/https): Configure HTTPS endpoints for receiving Shopify webhook events.
- [Webhook Event Topics](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/enums/WebhookSubscriptionTopic): Available webhook subscription topics in the Admin GraphQL API.
- [Bulk Operations](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/usage/bulk-operations/queries): Query large datasets asynchronously through Shopify GraphQL bulk operations.
- [Metafields](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/custom-data/metafields): Store and manage custom structured data on Shopify resources.
- [Metaobjects](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/custom-data/metaobjects): Define reusable custom content models for Shopify stores and apps.

## Guides and Tutorials
- [Tutorials](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/tutorials): Step-by-step tutorials for common Shopify app development tasks.
- [Getting Started](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/getting-started): Introductory path for new Shopify app developers.
- [Migration Guides](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/graphql/migrate): Guidance for moving app implementations toward GraphQL-based APIs.
- [Launch Checklist](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/launch): Requirements and recommendations for shipping production-ready Shopify apps.
- [Best Practices](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/best-practices): Recommended patterns for security, UX, performance, and platform compatibility.
- [Examples](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/examples): Example implementations and patterns for Shopify development.

## SDKs and Frameworks
- [Shopify App Remix](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/shopify-app-remix): Remix package and patterns for building embedded Shopify apps.
- [Shopify App React Router](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/shopify-app-react-router): React Router tooling for Shopify app authentication and embedded UX.
- [Admin API Libraries](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql#client-libraries): Official client library entry points for Admin GraphQL integrations.
- [Storefront API Libraries](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront#client-libraries): Client library options for Storefront API implementations.
- [Polaris](https://polaris.shopify.com/): Shopify’s design system for building consistent merchant-facing interfaces.
- [Shopify GitHub](https://github.com/Shopify): Open-source repositories, SDKs, examples, and platform tooling maintained by Shopify.
